messages.subject: Re: Ticket 48213: adding our logo
messages.body:
Hi Hannah,

To add your logo, go to Settings > Branding and upload a PNG. Since you moved over on October 1, note that custom fields from your old system don't carry across: under Settings > Invoice fields you can turn on a PO number field, set it per client, and it prints on every invoice. Existing invoices can be reissued with one click from the invoice menu.

Best,
Tom at Ledgerly Support

opportunities.what: Halverson Legal, Corvane Medical and Ridgeway Museum all rejected invoices for a missing PO number since October, and Ledgerly support explains that custom fields did not carry over in the October 1 move and that a PO field can be turned on per client with one-click reissue. Turn it on, reissue all three clients' invoices, and tell each the cause.

VoxLink raises six seats from $45 to $62 each on December 1, while the Guild offers Interprio at $38 per seat locked for two years, with sign-up closing November 30. Compare and decide before both dates.

Hannah confirmed she will personally interpret Halverson's deposition on Tuesday, November 17 from 9:30 am, and her court interpreter oral exam is the same morning at 10:00 in the capital, with rescheduling closing 7 days ahead. Reschedule one or find another interpreter now.
Arlo Robotics needs about 12 Japanese patent documents translated from January, and Mei Tanaka is a Japanese-English patent translator with capacity from December. Bring Mei in for the Arlo work.

Mum wants the old album photos scanned for Dad's 70th on December 12, and Femi needs good-resolution scans of the same albums by mid December for the family history book. One scanning session at decent resolution serves both.

Hannah is driving three boys to the Lakeport tournament on November 21 and staying over, but Jordan asked her to take Rachel out that afternoon and bring her back to the surprise party at 7:00 pm the same day. She can't do both and needs to tell one of them.

traps.what: Ridgeway Museum and Ridgeway Dental share only a name.
Diego and Lena both lost access to the shared drive in September, but Lucia upgraded the storage and both confirmed access the next day.
The summit pass and Petra's coffee invitation both point to October 22, which is already over.
The Corvane manual and the Ridgeway spring catalog both starting in early December are already joined in one open to-do.
Corvane's consent form due December 2 and Dad's knee surgery consent forms for December 2 share words and a date; work and family must not be joined.
Halverson Legal and Brandt & Kessler are competing law firms asking for the same 2027 volume pricing; they get separate replies and are never mentioned to each other.
Lena Fischer the German freelancer and Lena Fischer the science teacher are different people.
Corvane's office visit and the in-laws' holiday visit both have no dates, so there is nothing to clash.
The winter catalog and the car registration are both due December 4; they have nothing to do with each other.
Pinecrest's duplicate payment showed up as a second deposit, but Hannah refunded it and Marcy confirmed receipt.
